subject: Re: scanning hobby
text: Thanks for checking. I still enjoy film scans more than I expected, though the flatbed keeps losing edge alignment. It happens after three or four frames, usually on the first pass. I have cleaned the lid, switched cables, and tried a different outlet. The issue improved slightly, but it remains annoying. Next week I may take it in, unless a firmware patch appears. For now I am using a cardboard border and cropping the final files. I can live with it, though it eats time. I would be curious whether your scanner has shown similar drift.
